Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE new KFB landscape transparent PNG3x2 character sheet, exactly SIX unique absurd surreal weird expressive ink blob claymation monsters belonging to fictional retro sport club Reitverein Freier Zügel. Retro equestrian club with faded plum and cream collars, worn brown leather tack, velvet caps and country-sport details. Actual input1 is STYLE ONLY for rounded whole ink body/material;input2 STYLE ONLY for handcrafted props,not edit targets. Do not copy their costumes,face layout or repeated grins. Fresh personalities and mouth choreography. Offbeat warm satirical tactile stopmotion appeal,avoid glossy Pixar-human clichés.
ANATOMY LOCK: Each actor is a continuous full upright FOOTLESS charcoal-black ink splat with subtle dark violet sheen,soft thick asymmetric lobes,a few rounded droplets,huge face directly in goo and short goo hands. NO human torso/legs/feet/bust,no human skin,no animal/robot body. Sports conveyed by props/acting ONLY,not realistic sporting anatomy. All actors upright to camera,not swimming horizontally,not lying,not seated/mounted. Costumes SMALL collar/bib/shoulder accents,body goo dominant. Rich rounded softly modeled plasticine,subtle fingerprints,selective fabric/leather/wood/metalcues,upper-left soft studio light. Every eye WHITE/IVORY sclera RED iris BLACK pupil,thick fully filled darkviolet lids. Caps/masks/goggles never obscure eyes. Exactly2female-read subtle lashes/crest;no human anatomy. Six distinct expressions beyond6hat swaps. Teeth ONLY descend from upper gum INSIDE open mouth;never outside lowerlip;closed mouths toothless. Lips dark ink,avoid human pink lips. Few bold coherent props.

TOP MIDDLE — Hugo Hindernis, male-read. Squat wide asymmetric blob, one bent ink crest, crossed worried gaze and tense irregular upper teeth inside mouth; small plum riding helmet, cream scarf; hugs one miniature red-and-cream striped hurdle rail horizontally at waist, full rail clear of neighbours.
TOP RIGHT — Egon Querfeldein, male-read. Rugged offset-lobed pear blob, bold laughing side glance and three-upper-tooth open grin; brown flat cap, tiny plum neckerchief; holds one muddy tall riding BOOT as separate hand prop and a folded blank route map tucked at flank, no feet.

Narrow teardrop blob with upturned side crest and lashes, eager huge eyes, pinched toothless anxious smile; tiny plum-and-cream striped jockey cap, small cream collar; hugs a tiny polished wooden hobbyhorse head on SHORT stick, clearly carved toy prop, not living extra creature.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — Walt Weiterzügel, male-read. Round broad puddle-lobed upright blob, sloping bored eyelids and long closed sideways scowl; small worn western hat, tiny plum bandana; holds ONE modest leather lasso coil in one goo hand, other hand at flank, NO gun.
BOTTOM RIGHT — Oskar Langstrecke, male-read. Tall wavy ink column with drooping curl, enormous weary-but-resolute eyes, small toothless exhale opening; old cream cloth riding cap, tiny plum collar; dented enamel water flask in hand, rolled saddle blanket over one shoulder, no saddle/horse scene.
